name: demo-studio
description: Builds client-branded UnifyApps demo assets from one request. A team of agents pulls client context from Slack, decides whether the demo is about the use case or the platform's configuration, asks Nebula about the platform instead of guessing, settles every clarifying question itself, builds nothing a beat does not use, lets the installed Nebula plugin build the result, and rehearses the demo in a browser. Requires the Nebula plugin.
